description_en: Adds a tracking number for a private number in the AXN binding
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi add-axn-track-no --pool-key FC22350000 --phone-nox 17000000000 --track-no abcde00000 --subs-id 156788900000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddAxnTrackNo

parameters.help_en: The key of the phone number pool. Log on to the Phone Number Protection console (https://dypls.console.aliyun.com/dypls.htm#/account) and view the key of the phone number pool on the Number Pool Management page
parameters.help_zh: 号码池Key。请登录号码隐私保护控制台 (https://dypls.console.aliyun.com/dypls.htm#/account)，在号码池管理中查看号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The private number in the AXN binding, that is, phone number X.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110258.html operation to obtain the value of PhoneNoX
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系中的隐私号码，即X号码。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110258.html接口获取
parameters.name: phone_nox

parameters.help_en:
The binding ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110258.html operation to obtain the value of SubsId
parameters.help_zh:
订购关系ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110258.html接口获取
parameters.name: subs_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful.
Other values indicate that the request failed. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
